PRE-TECHNICAL STUDIES — MOCK EXAM #5
====

GRADE: Grade 9
SUBJECT: PRE-TECHNICAL STUDIES
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Remove all guards
   B. Work alone with eyes closed
   C. Run with the tool
   D. Wear safety gear and follow instructions

2. When learning Wood 8 3.2 Handling Waste Materials 8 4.0. Tools and Production 4.1 Holding Tool, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Wood 8 3.2 Handling Waste Materials 8 4.0. Tools and Production 4.1 Holding Tool.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Wood 8 3.2 Handling Waste Materials 8 4.0. Tools and Production 4.1 Holding Tool.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Wood 8 3.2 Handling Waste Materials 8 4.0. Tools and Production 4.1 Holding Tool.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Wood 8 3.2 Handling Waste Materials 8 4.0. Tools and Production 4.1 Holding Tool.

3. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. Internal Cooking Timer
   B. Information and Communication Technology
   C. International Cricket Team
   D. Input Cable Tester

4. When learning Safety on Raised Platforms, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Safety on Raised Platforms.

   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Visual Programming 15 3.0 Materials for Production 3.1 Wood 8 3.2 Handling Waste.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Visual Programming 15 3.0 Materials for Production 3.1 Wood 8 3.2 Handling Waste.

7. When learning Holding Tools 8 4.2 Driving Tools 8 4.3 Project 20 5.0 Entrepreneurship 5.1 Fina, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)

   A. Skip safety briefings for Holding Tools.

   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Holding Tools.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Holding Tools.

10. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)

   B. Speaker
